notes: A framed literal character sequence with a declared type. Its payload is quoted data; embedded expression markers are not evaluated.
A nonempty framed name. Naming an object does not itself dereference or invoke it.
ASCII Latin letter or digit (0-9 A-Z a-z)

One expression in statement position: a value expression or an assignment. This is not an arbitrary unframed character sequence. Additional routine forms require explicit operand boundaries before inclusion.
One value expression: a quoted literal or an explicit object reference or routine invocation. Matching this syntax does not evaluate it; literal payloads are never implicitly reparsed as expressions.
